title: The groomer at night
notes: Ridge cat track, normalized date 0.87, sim clock about 20:40 (a time jump of 215 minutes from 17:05; the groomer's lights are on). The groomer drives south up the track along x 4379 at about 3.2 m/s (sim speed 1); find it with __groomers() (ids change per load: it was 90072:7). Run the sim until its InterpolatedTransform z is below -2449, pause, then arm capture mode and start. The track runs across a slope that keeps rising to the east (no crest), so the camera stands 13 m west (downhill), 1.5 m above the snow, and looks up: the machine stands against the sky over the slope line. Two campath steps: 2 s with Time of Day 16.2 to 17.0 (the last of the dusk into night), then 8 s at 17.0 with a 3 m truck south (the camera holds still for the first 2 s); ground under the path 1448.1 to 1448.7. Both follow the groomer (look-at = its drawn position + 1.5 m). At Time of Day 17.0 the sky is night with stars and the moon lights the snow; 17.3 reads the same (stills b12-g, b12-h).

trigger.when: z below -2449, paused there before the take

take2.notes: Same mark and path, 40 mm, Time of Day 16.2 to 16.8 then held at 16.8 (a little more sky light; the moon enters the frame). The groomer returned to the mark after a full round trip of the track (south end near 4323, -2616, north end near 4406, -2347).
